_comment: Expansion 3 part D.2: level 5 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

antilife_shell.name: Antilife Shell
antilife_shell.text: An aura 10 feet around you (concentration, an hour): every creature but the undead and constructs attacks you, and the friends who stand in it, with disadvantage. The book bars them from passing the barrier at all.

banishing_smite.name: Banishing Smite
banishing_smite.text: Readied on the blow (concentration): the next melee hit adds 5d10 force. If that leaves the foe at 50 hit points or fewer, it must make a Charisma save or be sent to a harmless pocket world, helpless, until your concentration ends.

bigbys_hand.name: Bigby's Hand
bigbys_hand.text: A great hand of force appears within 120 feet (concentration, ten minutes) and strikes at once: a melee spell attack for 5d8 force. A bonus action each turn moves it and strikes again. Only the Clenched Fist is here. Each higher slot adds 2d8.

circle_of_power.name: Circle of Power
circle_of_power.text: A shining circle 30 feet around you (concentration, ten minutes): you and your friends in it have advantage on saves against spells and other magic, and take no damage at all when a save would halve it.

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
cloudkill.text: Yellow-green fog fills a 20-foot radius up to 120 feet away (concentration, ten minutes), thick enough to hide in: all caught, or who walk in or end a turn there, make a Constitution save or take 5d8 poison, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d8. The fog does not drift.

conjure_elemental.name: Conjure Elemental
conjure_elemental.text: A Large spirit of fire rises within 50 feet (concentration, ten minutes). Whoever is caught near it, or comes close, makes a Dexterity save or takes 8d8 fire and is held fast; each turn after, a save frees it, a failure burns for 4d8. Each higher slot adds 2d8.

conjure_volley.name: Conjure Volley
conjure_volley.text: Hundreds of spectral weapons fall on a 40-foot radius up to 150 feet away: your foes there make a Dexterity save or take 8d8 force, half on a save.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.text: Your touch plants a sickness: a foe makes a Constitution save or takes 11d8 necrotic and is poisoned, trying to shake it off at the end of each of its turns. One success ends it here; the book asks for three.

destructive_wave.name: Destructive Wave
destructive_wave.text: Thunder and holy light ripple out 30 feet from you: your foes there make a Constitution save or take 5d6 thunder and 5d6 radiant and fall prone; a save takes half. The book lets you choose necrotic for the light; here it is radiant.

dispel_evil_and_good.name: Dispel Evil and Good

again.name: Dispel Evil and Good: dismissal
again.text: While the ward holds, an action dismisses one celestial, elemental, fey, fiend or undead foe within 5 feet: a Charisma save or it is sent away until your concentration ends.

dispel_evil_and_good.text: A holy ward on you (concentration, a minute): celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and the undead attack you with disadvantage. An action can dismiss one such foe beside you (Charisma save). The Break Enchantment option is left out.

dominate_person.name: Dominate Person
dominate_person.text: A person within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, with advantage while you fight it, or falls under your will (concentration, a minute) and fights on your side. Each time it is hurt it saves again, and a success breaks the hold.

greater_restoration.name: Greater Restoration

material.text: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

greater_restoration.text: A touch that lifts a blight: a petrification, or else a charm, on a creature is undone. The book's other cures (exhaustion, curses, drained scores or hit points) are not in the game. It consumes diamond dust worth 100 gold.

insect_plague.name: Insect Plague
insect_plague.text: Biting locusts fill a 20-foot radius up to 300 feet away (concentration, ten minutes): hard going, and all caught, or who enter or end a turn there, make a Constitution save or take 4d10 piercing, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

jallarzis_storm_of_radiance.name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
jallarzis_storm_of_radiance.text: A storm of light and thunder in a 10-foot radius up to 120 feet away (concentration, a minute): all caught, or who enter or end a turn there, make saves against 2d10 radiant and 2d10 thunder, half on a save; a failure also blinds until the turn ends.

steel_wind_strike.name: Steel Wind Strike
steel_wind_strike.text: You vanish and strike like the wind: five melee spell attacks, each 6d10 force, at foes within 30 feet. One blow for each foe in reach, the chosen one first; you do not teleport beside them afterwards.

swift_quiver.name: Swift Quiver

again.name: Swift Quiver: two more shots
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action makes two more shots with your weapon.

swift_quiver.text: A bonus action (concentration, a minute): your weapon makes two attacks at once from a quiver that never empties, and each later turn a bonus action makes two more. They use your casting modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity.

synaptic_static.name: Synaptic Static
synaptic_static.text: Psychic energy bursts in a 20-foot radius up to 120 feet away: 8d6 psychic, Intelligence save for half, friends included. A failure leaves a muddled mind: 1d6 off its attack rolls until it saves at the end of a turn.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis

again.name: Telekinesis: the grip
again.text: While the spell holds, an action seizes a foe the same way, the one held before or another.

telekinesis.text: Your will grips a foe within 50 feet (concentration, ten minutes): a Strength save or it is flung 30 feet and held fast until the end of your next turn. An action each later turn seizes a foe the same way. Moving objects is not in the game.

wall_of_force.name: Wall of Force
wall_of_force.text: An unseen wall of force fills a 10-foot-radius patch within 120 feet (concentration, ten minutes). Nothing passes it and nothing harms it; creatures standing there are left in their places, outside the wall's squares.

wall_of_stone.name: Wall of Stone
wall_of_stone.text: A wall of solid stone fills a block 20 feet across within 120 feet (concentration, ten minutes). Nothing passes it; creatures standing there are left in their places. It is gone when the spell ends, and it cannot be broken down.

yolandes_regal_presence.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
yolandes_regal_presence.text: Unearthly majesty surrounds you to 10 feet (concentration, a minute): foes who come into it or end a turn there make a Wisdom save or take 4d6 psychic, half on a save. The book's fall prone and push are not in the game.
